steps.prompt: Before the check: which pattern from Estimation do you use most, and which do you still have to think about?
steps.placeholder: I use… I still think about…

cards.title: Estimating: quick review
cards.body: Round to friendly numbers first, then calculate: $47 + 38 \approx 90$, $48 \times 21 \approx 1000$, $247 \div 6 \approx 40$.

cards.title: Checking: quick review
cards.body: Compare with an estimate, and check the last digit: $47 \times 38$ must end in $6$ because $7 \times 8 = 56$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you’ll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.

prompts: Where could you use a pattern from Estimation outside school?
